regions.today: Cloudy and breezy this evening with a few patches of drizzle. Winds easing a little as the evening goes on.
regions.tonight: Tonight will be cloudy with further patchy drizzle as well as hill and coastal fog. A mild, humid night with lowest temperatures of 11 to 14 degrees. Westerly winds will freshen again overnight.
regions.tomorrow: Cloudy with patchy drizzle to start on Friday, but it will begin to clear in the morning with brighter, blustery conditions following. A chance of mist or fog lingering on southeast coasts into the afternoon. Highest temperatures of 17 to 20 degrees, mildest further to the southeast, all in a fresh westerly wind.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate to high on Friday and Saturday.
